oldText: The Hub asks visitors to pre-sort recycling and bring items clean and dry. Visitors place materials in the relevant bins, with volunteers available for questions. Unloading, lifting and carrying assistance are not promised; arrange any essential help in advance.
newText: The Hub asks visitors to pre-sort recycling as much as possible and bring items clean and dry. Visitors place materials in the relevant bins, with volunteers available for questions. Unloading, lifting and carrying assistance are not promised; arrange any essential help in advance.
quote: Review our list of what we take, and pre-sort items as much as possible.
